connections.why: My Music develops the repertoire and technique used in solo performance
Solo control of an instrument is the basis for playing in an ensemble
Understanding your role in wider contexts supports ensemble playing
Free composition skills are then applied to the constraints of a set brief
Studying concerto conventions models the structures used when composing to a brief
Pop conventions provide accessible models for free composition
Film music's word/mood painting informs composing to a descriptive brief
Orchestral and tonal techniques link the concerto to film scoring
World rhythmic patterns feed into popular music styles and fusion
Performing on your instrument deepens understanding of solo concerto writing
World rhythms offer rich material for original composition
Pop and band textures are a common context for ensemble performance
Both draw on amplified, modern instrumentation and production techniques
Knowing an instrument's idioms helps write idiomatic original music
